children: The CBOT soybean November contract (SX26) may end its bounce around resistance at $13.24 per bushel, and retest the support at $13.12.
An ascending triangle looks like a top pattern, as it mainly consists of a wave 4 and a wave 5, the final two waves of a five-wave cycle.
A break below $13.15-3/4 may trigger a fall into the $13.07-1/4 to $13.12 range, while a break above $13.24 could lead to a gain to $13.31-1/2.
